note: CadBridge build baseline. Populated and locked during P0. Do not use floating versions.

host.reason: Host is not constrained by the CAD process runtime. .NET 8 support ends 2026-11-10 (DESIGN S02). .NET 10 is the current LTS.

legacy.reason: AutoCAD 2015-2024 hosts run on .NET Framework; verified by acad.exe.config bindingRedirects and absence of acdbmgd.runtimeconfig.json

modern.reason: AutoCAD 2025 and 2026 ship acdbmgd.runtimeconfig.json with tfm net8.0; verified on this machine

plugin.boundary: 2025 is the first Modern host on this machine. AutoCAD 2026 <= Update 1.1 vs >= Update 1.2 remains to be verified separately (ACCEPTANCE A19).

packages.note: Exact versions, licenses and dependency graphs are recorded in docs/evidence/P0/<run>/raw/source-register.json by the P0 source audit.

reference_assemblies.policy: Autodesk managed assemblies are HINT-PATH compile references only and are never copied into the green package.
